name: Osanai Shouko
source:
Protagonist of the story, a 2nd year student at Seijou Academy. Her nickname is "Osa". She's the well-liked, ace of the kendo team who takes on the role of captain after the former 3rd year captain retires. Since she is the serious and hardworking type, she often gets teased and is on the receiving end of jokes.
[From [url=http://www.solelo.com/aoishiro/pc/characters.htm]Solelo website[/url]]
